verdict.summary: Sound LCC franchise hit by 2026 Middle East airspace closures and an ~85% spike in jet fuel costs. Q3 2026 revenue rose 19% YoY to EUR 1,314M and Q3 EBITDA was EUR 404M (margin compressed 520bp YoY to 30.7%), leaving 9M26 EBITDA down 30% YoY at EUR 486M and a EUR 40M 9M net loss. Liquidity (EUR 1,134M cash at 30-Jun-26) and 2031 maturity runway protect near-term solvency.

positives: Strong Q3 top-line resilience: Q3 2026 revenue +19% YoY to EUR 1,314M (TRY 72.2bn) with EUR 404M EBITDA (+2% YoY).
Adequate liquidity runway: EUR 1,134M cash at 30-Jun-26 and 2026 notes refinanced into $500m 2031 Eurobond (no near-term bond wall).
Industry-leading CASK ex-fuel unit cost structure in EMEA low-cost aviation.
negatives: Margin compression: 9M26 EBITDA fell 30% YoY to EUR 486M (17.2% margin) with a EUR 40M 9M net loss due to +85% jet fuel prices and Middle East airspace disruptions.
Negative rating outlooks: Both Fitch (BB-) and S&P (B+) moved outlooks to Negative in May-Jun 2026; Fitch sees 2026E EBITDAR net leverage at 6.2x.
Most Middle East-exposed rated EMEA LCC; sustained conflict/fuel spike into 2027 would delay deleveraging toward 3.8x.
